Direction C · Soft product — Settings (original sketch)

annotations.text:
Visibility rules (show information when relevant; hide it otherwise)

Engine-card status pill: Ready / Translating / Fallback active / Language pack required. One place for all states, no counts.

While translation is on: hide arrows on engine and language rows (changes are unavailable).

Show only when applicable: failure row (beside engine card), fallback explanation (inside engine card).

Non-arXiv page: hide engine card and buttons.

Settings: show LLM form only when LLM is selected; show Connect only after fields change; put thinking mode under More options; show custom CSS only for Custom; dim Prompts & terms and show a hint for non-LLM engines.

Code behavior changes required for implementation

1. Default engine becomes google-web (usable on first open)
2. Language-pack download: expanded popup engine list + settings engine card, both triggered by clicks
3. Connect = setConfig first, then explicitly test one sentence with the engine selected in the current form; test form values
4. Save all controls immediately except the LLM form; remove global save
5. Map failure reasons to plain language: timeout / quota exhausted / invalid translation format / expired key
6. Show the same sentence while loading and on non-arXiv pages
7. Use stepped sliders for translate-ahead distance and threshold, mapped internally to margin / threshold
The reading toolbar remains a proposal: while translation is on, switching modes / restoring the original would no longer require clicking the toolbar icon. Whether to implement it is your decision.
